categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Removes btck_chain_get_genesis and btck_chain_get_tip from the libbitcoinkernel C API wrapper.
categories.rationale: Trims redundant accessor functions from the public C API to minimize surface area prior to stabilization. As noted by TheCharlatan, these redundant methods provide marginal benefit now that dedicated chain iteration exists.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label, validation explicitly excludes changes whose primary subject is the libbitcoinkernel API.
categories.rationale: The PR only alters libbitcoinkernel C API wrappers and does not touch validation rules, block index logic, or consensus code.
